explanation: A person in Genesis, father of Rachel and Leah and father-in-law to Jacob.
One of the patriarchs in the Bible, son of Isaac and Rebekah, and father of the twelve tribes of Israel.
Jacob's favorite wife and mother of Joseph and Benjamin, younger sister of Leah.
Jacob's first wife and mother of six of his twelve sons, older sister of Rachel.
A tree mentioned in Genesis 31, used by Jacob to influence the livestock offspring.
An agreement between two parties, often with religious significance, as in this case between Jacob and Laban.
A type of stone mentioned in Genesis 31, likely used as a boundary marker or witness in the covenant between Jacob and Laban.
A geographical area east of the Jordan River, where Jacob and Laban made their covenant.
